## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed interface.
- [ ] `npm run check:all` passes.
- [ ] Required real-app or packaged-app verification is recorded with sanitized evidence.

## Contract review

- [ ] Canonical feature, architecture, protocol, and maintenance docs are updated where required.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible behavior.
- [ ] Private-interface limits and unverified assumptions are explicit.
- [ ] No prompts, answers, credentials, raw payloads, stable identifiers, or local-only artifacts
      are included.
